subjects.description: A cluster of identical white passenger vehicles, clean modern compact sedans with smooth painted bodywork, arranged and slowly repositioning among the marked parking bays of a depot
subjects.appearance_details: Glossy white paint reflecting faint overhead lights, dark tinted windows, chrome-trimmed grilles, illuminated red tail lights and white headlights, uniform fleet appearance suggesting an autonomous or rental fleet
subjects.relationship: Fleet vehicles sharing the depot with the ego car; one of them directly confronts the ego vehicle by pulling out of its bay
subjects.location: Center and mid background, spread across the marked bays ahead
subjects.orientation: Various; the primary vehicle faces the camera nose to nose, others angled within their bays
subjects.pose: Vehicles at rest and in slow rolling motion within and out of bays
subjects.action: Slowly repositioning among bays, one pulling forward directly ahead of the ego vehicle
subjects.state_changes: The lead white vehicle rolls out of its bay toward the ego car, then halts nose to nose as both come to a stop

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, an unseen car from which the first-person driving perspective is captured, its front hood faintly visible at the bottom edge of frame
subjects.appearance_details: Dark dashboard reflections in the lower frame, headlight beams projecting forward onto the depot floor and the white vehicle ahead
subjects.relationship: The observer's vehicle that brakes, stops, and flashes headlights at the white vehicle blocking its path
subjects.orientation: Facing forward into the depot, toward the white vehicles
subjects.action: Rolling forward, braking, stopping fully, and flashing its headlights repeatedly
subjects.state_changes: Transitions from slow motion to a complete stop; its headlight beams pulse on and off as it flashes

background_setting: A large indoor vehicle depot at night, dimly lit by scattered overhead fluorescent and sodium fixtures. The concrete floor is painted with white and yellow parking bay lines, some faded and scuffed. Rows of identical white vehicles occupy the marked bays, receding into the shadowy depth of the facility. Structural steel columns and low ceiling ductwork are barely visible in the darkness, and the far end of the depot fades into near-total blackness.

lighting.conditions: Dim artificial night lighting, low ambient illumination with pooled light beneath fixtures
lighting.direction: Top-down overhead lighting supplemented by the ego vehicle's forward-facing headlights
lighting.shadows: Long, soft shadows cast by vehicles across the painted floor; deep shadow pockets between bays
lighting.illumination_effect: Moody, low-contrast wash punctuated by bright headlight pools and reflective glints off white paint and chrome

aesthetics.composition: Central one-point perspective down the depot lanes, ego hood anchoring the lower frame, lead white vehicle centered ahead, other vehicles flanking in the mid ground
aesthetics.color_scheme: Muted cool palette of grays and blues with warm amber highlights, dominated by white vehicle bodies and glowing red tail lights and white headlights
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Tense, eerie, uncanny standoff, quiet nighttime unease
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating rows of identical white vehicles and rhythmic parking bay lines

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:02, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from driver's first-person viewpoint
cinematography.focus: The lead white vehicle pulling out directly ahead

context: Autonomous or fleet vehicle depot navigation scenario, first-person driving footage depicting a near-miss standoff

actions.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:02.
One white vehicle pulls out of its bay directly into the ego vehicle's path; the ego vehicle brakes; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

The ego vehicle comes to a complete stop nose to nose with the pulling-out vehicle and flashes its headlights repeatedly while remaining fully stationary; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Stenciled white block letters on the concrete floor, worn and partly faded
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: On the floor within the marked bay ahead, visible throughout
text_and_signage_elements.context: Identifies the numbered parking bay from which the white vehicle emerges

audio_description: Low ambient hum of a large indoor facility, faint electrical buzz of overhead lights, the soft whir and tire scuff of slow-moving vehicles, a subtle brake squeal as the ego car stops, and the faint mechanical click of headlights flashing on and off. No speech or music, tense quiet atmosphere.
